groups.defect: The CountDevices check and the INSERT run without a transaction or lock, so concurrent new devices can push the count past the configured device limit.
groups.rationale: All three report the same TOCTOU race on the same lines of CreateOrUpdateDevice.

groups.defect: tagDeviceUI writes the local cache entry before CreateOrUpdateDevice, so a failed or limit-rejected device stays cached for 29 minutes and later requests skip the limit.
groups.rationale: All three point at the same cache write placed before the DB call in tagDeviceUI, and moving SetDefault fixes all of them.

groups.defect: updateDevice returns ErrDeviceLimitReached when 0 rows are affected, which also happens for an existing device whose updated_at is outside the window, so client.go rejects that returning device.
groups.rationale: Both describe the same mix-up between a stale existing device and the limit being reached in updateDevice, and the same wrongful rejection that follows.

groups.defect: ErrDeviceLimitReached is a bare fmt.Errorf returned from Anonymous.Authenticate, so it reaches users as a generic authentication or 500 failure instead of a typed error with a proper status code.
groups.rationale: Both point at client.go lines 44-50 and ask for the error to be wrapped in a typed authn/errutil error with a deliberate status.
